harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: a set of producers under TWO predicates on ONE write barrier (kind ord with pguard): `@P0 LDG.E.128` + `@P2 LDG.E`, the 2-set of an attention kernel; each predicate true | false | a bit of the lane | a bit of the iteration counter in ten layouts, both written at the top of every iteration by ISETP.GE.AND; warm and cold lines; the two loads 1 and 4 cycles apart; the reader takes every destination register behind ONE wait, 2 cycles behind the last arming and (four layouts) 129 cycles behind it; a nullified load leaves its destination's marker; every request with the reader's wait but the one in which nothing executes has its positive control - the same text with that ONE wait bit moved to the first instruction behind the reader's (the producers keep their barrier) - on a Workstation Edition card, beside a sustained load at the 400-W limit

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
conditions.load: the shipped attention kernel sparse_mla_prefill_v41 (sha256 c896234b...) in its timing loop, a second process on the same card

provenance.dep_table_commit: ff2a2c1 tools/stallfloor/README: the class of the first result of probe_sm120_20261112_b50.json

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
